fact: The National Bureau of Statistics with UNICEF released the results of the 2025 South Sudan MICS on 21 April 2026, sampling 12,000 households and interviewing over 10,000 across all states.

The plan cites the 2008 Sudan Housing and Population Census as having recorded a disability prevalence of 5.1% in South Sudan (424,000 of 8.28 million), though the census is described as controversial; no enumeration date is given beyond the year.
Eye Radio reported on 21 April 2026 that the National Bureau of Statistics, with UNICEF, released the 2025 Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey covering more than 10,000 households nationwide.
Radio Tamazuj quotes the NBS chair saying the Council of Ministers approved the budget for the census, which is still awaiting funding.
